description: This source file implements the restore job functionality for configuration restoration, including downloading configuration files, notifying services, handling callbacks, and managing service restarts during a restore process in a network device or embedded system.

methods.name: isRestoreRunning
methods.description: Checks if a restore process is currently in progress, used to prevent concurrent restores.

methods.name: startRestoreProcess
methods.description: Initiates the restore process, populates steps, and starts the restore thread if not already running.

methods.name: notifyRestoreCallback
methods.description: Handles callback notifications from services about restore status, updating internal lists accordingly.

methods.name: extractConfig
methods.description: Downloads the configuration archive, extracts it into a temporary directory, and runs the restore script.

methods.name: restoreThread
methods.description: Performs the sequence of steps to restore configuration, notify services, and restart services.

methods.name: waitForServiceCallbacks
methods.description: Waits for all services to report restore completion or timeout.

methods.name: waitForServiceRestarts
methods.description: Stops and restarts services as needed, waiting for each to complete.

methods.name: tellAllServices
methods.description: Informs all registered services of the restore directory and manages their restore actions.
